message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts: selling obscene DVDs for profit. Chinese criminal law: "制作、复制、出版、贩卖、传播淫秽物品罪" (selling obscene materials). Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But primary is "传播淫秽物品罪" (selling). The law: Article 363 of Criminal Law: "制作、复制、出版、贩卖、传播淫秽物品的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the crime is "传播淫秽物品罪". Also "非法经营罪" if business without license? But the fact only mentions selling obscene DVDs for profit. So the crime is "传播淫秽物品罪". Could also be "非法经营罪" if selling pornographic materials is illegal business. However the law specifically addresses obscene materials. So answer: [罪名]传播淫秽物品罪<eoa>
